new.why_it_matters: A legal land description (plan numbers, 'PART 1 25R6353') is altered: the line starting with a plan-part number becomes a bullet '- 1', and the line order is swapped so the easement clause precedes the plan reference. Search for the parcel or quoting it gives the wrong text.
new.lesson: Do not treat a leading digit in an indented, unnumbered block as a list marker; keep lines of one paragraph in position order; tag legal descriptions as one block.
